BiblicalUsage: The word names something baked, a batch from the oven, and it appears once, in the law of the meat offering: if a man brings an oblation baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God receives the ordinary work of the oven, and unleavened bread offered in obedience is as holy as any sacrifice.
